text:
Aisha: quick ask  can QuantumRack give us a 3.5hr bench window Friday to validate their microkernel perf/W changes? want a compact deliverable for marketplace + partner blog.
Dev: Friday works for ops, keep scope tight: baseline, microkernel v2.1 tuned, and quant variant.
Ravi: success metrics: tokens/sec @ seq=1024, mean watts from rack PDU, 95th perc latency, and tokens/sec per watt. also capture GPU temps.
Marta: marketplace needs a single stat + tiny chart. I can draft blurb if we have numbers and a mock.
Aisha: kernel tag `qr/microk-2.1` and quant profile `q4_fast`. runtime image `redwood/infer:bench-2026-04-10`.
Dev: lab checklist: SNMP creds, per-GPU telemetry, KVM, kernel tarball. who can get creds from QuantumRack ops?
Ravi: tagging ops: @quantum_ops_liam  can you share which SNMP OIDs map to per-board watts and if you can expose per-card readings for our slot?
quantum_ops_liam: yes, will DM OIDs and creds. note: QuantumRack requires a short NDA addendum and a 5-business-day review window on public material.
Marta: legal caveat noted. we'll keep public naming generic like "QuantumRack test cluster" if needed.
Aisha: schedule: Fri 09:00 smoke, 09:15 baseline, 10:00 deploy kernel+warmup, 10:15 tuned run, 11:15 quant run, 11:45 collect & teardown.
Dev: command draft: `./run.sh --model smalllm.onnx --seq 1024 --iters 1200 --profile q4_fast --log csv > out.csv`  will toggle `--pkv` and `--power-sample=1s` for variants.
Ravi: please include `--thermals=true` if runtime supports it. retention: raw CSVs private for 30 days, partner review before public.
Marta: I'll prepare a 150-word blurb and a chart mock by Thu EOD. aim for joint blog + marketplace badge pending partner ok.
Aisha: action items: Ravi (bench script + graphs), Dev (telemetry + creds), Marta (copy + chart), Aisha (legal + PM coord). I'll send calendar invite and 15m preflight Fri 08:30 PT.
bench-bot: scheduled run created: `quantum-mini-1778123456`  logs to `s3://redwood-partners/quantumrack/mini/1778123456/`.
quantum_ops_liam: sending creds and OIDs to Dev in DM. NDA addendum draft incoming.
Dev: got creds, prepping SNMP scrape and small prometheus job. :thumbsup:
Aisha: thanks team  sync Fri 08:30 PT.
Marta: noted, will have blurb and a mock chart ready.
